Check that your API key is valid and not expired, the Maps JavaScript API is enabled, the key allows this app, and you are online. You can change the map provider in Settings → Map.

Checking the routing data for updates…
brouter.de has newer routing data for this route: %1$s. Update to download it, or route now with the data on this device; this asks again in a week.

This route needs %1$s of routing data from brouter.de: areas not yet on this device, which the route cannot do without, and newer data for areas already here. The data stays on this device for later routes.
No place could be read from what the other app sent.
Didn\'t catch that. Tap the mic to try again.
No connection for speech. Tap to retry.
Voice input failed. Tap to retry.
Show the status icons beside the dock buttons, where the dock has room for them. Long-press an icon to reorder or hide just that one.
Could not load the font list. Check the connection and reopen.
Follows the Theme setting above. Turn off to set the map\'s light or dark mode independently.
Not set — the Standard scheme shows until you enter one

The address of a hosted MapLibre style, for example https://example.org/styles/basic/style.json — the https:// scheme is required, and a provider key may be part of the address. The map loads the style as published: its own tiles, sprites and glyphs, and its own credits in place of the app\'s. If the style cannot be loaded, the map shows a notice; use Clear to return to the Standard scheme.
Keep north at the top of the map instead of rotating with the direction of travel. The on-map compass toggles this too.
3D elevation relief (Mapterhorn). Adds tile downloads; heavier on low-end GPUs.
Default (%1$s) — tap to use your own server

Optional. The origin that serves the map\'s tiles, styles, sprites and glyphs in the OpenFreeMap layout, for example https://tiles.example.org — the https:// scheme is required. Every request the default host would receive goes to this one instead; if it cannot be reached, the map returns to the default host on its next retry.
Save regions of the map on this device. The map does not draw them yet.
None on this device yet. A route downloads the areas it needs.
Compute a new route when the vehicle leaves the one on the map.
After the first route, look for up to two more to choose from.
Bring the route back after a restart
Keep the route on this device so it returns when the launcher starts again. Off deletes the kept route.
Shown in the speed readout, beside the distance left.
Show the next turn over the map while a route is on.
A small second arrow when two turns follow closely.
Also show where the route goes straight on across a bigger road.
Say each turn before it comes, in English, through this device\'s text-to-speech engine.
This device has no text-to-speech engine.
No text-to-speech engine on this device has an English voice.
Keep the vehicle on the route
Draw the vehicle on the route line while it drives along it. Off draws it at the GPS position.
Each file covers a 5° × 5° area. A route checks the areas it uses for newer data from brouter.de at most once a week, and asks before downloading any.
This frees %1$s on this device. A route through this area downloads it again.

Map color schemes apply to OpenStreetMap only
Not set — tap to enter your API key

Paste a Google Maps Platform API key. Requires a Google Cloud project with billing enabled and the Maps JavaScript API enabled, and the key\'s HTTP-referrer restriction must allow https://appassets.androidplatform.net/*. In-vehicle use is subject to Google Maps Platform terms (your responsibility); usage may incur Google billing.
Not set — tap to add one for cloud styling and advanced markers

Optional. Enter a Map ID created in your Google Cloud console (Map Management) for cloud styling and advanced markers. It does not control raster vs vector — the Rendering setting above does, except on Automatic, where the map ID\'s cloud configuration decides. For the map to darken with the dark theme, associate a dark-mode style with the map ID in the Cloud console; without a map ID the default dark scheme applies.
Read the terms your own key is used under, including the restrictions on in-vehicle use

Vector adds heading-up rotation and tilt; raster is flat and north-up. Automatic follows the map ID\'s cloud configuration, and renders raster when no map ID is set. Vector needs no map ID, but on a device without WebGL it shows a notice instead of a map; choose Raster or Automatic there.
How often position updates are requested. Shorter is smoother; longer reduces load on slow head units. Many GNSS chips cap at one update per second regardless.
Skip updates closer than this to the last position; 0 delivers every fix.
Keep measuring distance and average speed while you use another app, such as navigation. Runs continuous GPS with an ongoing notification, so it uses more power.
Record position, speed, bearing, and altitude while driving, for later visualization. The history stays on this device.
Save the recorded history as a GPX file.
All recorded track points are removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
Show only the date, weekday and month on the dashboard card.
Show a spectrum of the playing audio behind the playback controls; uses the audio-capture (microphone) permission.
Show the album name on the music card and the full-screen player.
Show the album artwork on the music card and the full-screen player.
Play a video file from this device in a small window over the map.
The picture shows only a few seconds after GPS reads the vehicle as stopped. Audio keeps playing.

Many places ban video the driver can see while driving, including when stopped at lights or in traffic. Some also require the engine to be off. This app can\'t tell whether your vehicle is parked. Turn this off only if the screen is out of the driver\'s view or local law allows it, and follow the law where you drive.

For a confirmation closed without an answer, or held back while the vehicle moved.

Download the latest version in a browser instead.
The new version is installed and running.
Probe the spectrum while music is playing: silence here with an active session means the player bypasses the audio mixer.
Google Maps key, Map ID, custom style URL, tile host
The dock, pinned and hidden apps, saved places and the track history are not reset here.
This restores every setting in this section to its default value. Keys and addresses you entered are kept.
This restores the dock\'s button order and visibility, and the status icons\' order and visibility, to their defaults.

Each source is listed above with its license text and links.

Typography is provided on demand by Google Fonts, each family under its own SIL Open Font License (OFL) or Apache License 2.0. Fonts are downloaded and cached on the device; none are bundled in the app.
Ongoing notification shown while distance and average speed are measured in the background.
